recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. If a Jurisdiction ValueSet expansion issue recurs, address it in THO/UTG or terminology publication tooling rather than reintroducing or editing the old core value set.
issue_request: FHIR-20375 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I issue raised against STU3 and applied for R5. It reported that the Jurisdiction ValueSet expansion page showed a publication-tooling error: unable to provide support for code system urn:iso:std:iso:3166:-2.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-20375 was found. The resolution and FHIR-I minutes characterize this as a known tooling/publication issue, and the checked R5 publication page now renders expansion content instead of the reported error.
additional_context: Same-family issues FHIR-14695 and FHIR-18280 reported earlier Jurisdiction ValueSet expansion failures; FHIR-31537 later resolved no-change because the current build expanded successfully. UP-521 moved the needed Jurisdiction ValueSet CLD to THO, and FHIR-37971 separately aligned the ISO 3166 2-letter helper value set CLD.
reconciliation: Made no source changes. Current FHIR core source has no source/terminologies/valueset-jurisdiction.xml, active non-SVG Jurisdiction bindings use http://terminology.hl7.org/ValueSet/jurisdiction, and the R5/THO publication checks do not show the unable-to-expand text.

related_jiras.note: Earlier Published issue in the same jurisdiction expansion failure family; already represented on the combined branch by an empty no-change audit commit.

Implemented the THO Jurisdiction ValueSet with the same CLD after the core value set was deprecated/moved.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive FHIR-I issue reporting that the Jurisdiction ValueSet expansion failed because tooling could not support urn:iso:std:iso:3166:-2.
evidence_items.learned: The final decision was to fix a known expansion/tooling problem, not to remove ISO 3166-2 from the Jurisdiction ValueSet semantics.

evidence_items.summary: FHIR-I minutes record FHIR-20375 as persuasive because it was a known issue Grahame was trying to fix.
evidence_items.learned: Meeting evidence confirms the Jira vote and supports treating the issue as a publication/tooling correction.

evidence_items.summary: Current active core source includes the ISO 3166 helper value sets and binds Jurisdiction to http://terminology.hl7.org/ValueSet/jurisdiction.
evidence_items.learned: The current core build uses THO for Jurisdiction binding instead of maintaining the old broken core Jurisdiction ValueSet source.

evidence_items.summary: The 2025 cleanup commit deleted source/terminologies/valueset-jurisdiction.xml, whose parent version included ISO 3166, ISO 3166-2, and M49.
evidence_items.learned: The absence of the old core Jurisdiction ValueSet source is intentional current source evolution, not a missed FHIR-20375 edit.
